question: Can the Cycle 35 admitted L40S top-2-plus-no-shared arm use the named proven launcher without violating its hardware and spend contract?

runtime_source.mechanism: Glm4MoE constructs SharedFusedMoE with top_k=config.num_experts_per_tok and separately constructs shared_experts when config.n_shared_experts is present. Its CUDA native path uses moe_forward_shared whenever shared_experts is non-null.
runtime_source.local_patch_probe: A source-pinned copy changing exactly top_k to 2 and suppressing shared-expert construction compiled successfully with Python 3.12. This establishes a syntactically feasible runtime proxy only; it does not handle skipped shared-weight loading and is not a model-load or GPU result.

launcher_contract.conflict: The admitted experiment requires an L40S 1gpu-16vcpu-64gb session under $1.00. The named launcher currently creates an H100 venue and would derive more than $4.19 for 3,900 seconds before any provider overhead. It also stages no MoE patch and has no execution-equivalent no-mutation service mode.

next_move: A director or owner of the shared launcher must restore/identify the last L40S-capable vLLM launch path and add one source-hashed switch that (1) selects top_k=2, (2) prevents shared-expert execution while deliberately skipping only its checkpoint weights, and (3) retains an exact service-level no-mutation precreate artifact. Then this project may consume its one admitted session.
